test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If the code for LETTER is written as 1252072218 and BLISS is written as 2129198, then which of the given options will be the code for COMMON?
solution:
Table show alphabet serial number –

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55076ea54395deab263d9b051c59629eca76721df23f2e015a81f3f08dd2601e.png] 

Given: LETTER is written as 1252072218 and BLISS is written as 2129198.

The logic followed here is,

**1) Given letters in a word convert into alphabets place value.**

**2) If letters are repeated in a word so we use the opposite alphabet place value of the second repeated letter.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b69c50dea1ae291f110b91f1c01423f29e722b33560df1f185820db87de7e00.png] 

 

So the LETTER is written as 1252072218

And,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6056596bb6cd06224a24f6c68d89a8d6abdcb42d90830e27f2de67734889c92e.png] 

So the BLISS is written as 2129198.

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/881357778bfa411044f9673b88664f633d30e94f3fae17d67d8e8fd9ba162b08.png] 

Hence, 'COMMON' is coded as **'31513141214'**
